categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai CEO Environmental Protection Technology Co., Ltd. focuses on sludge dehydration and drying, solid-liquid separation, odor and volatile organic compound purification, energy-saving and carbon reduction technologies, and integrated carbon services. Its main products include low-temperature vacuum dehydration and drying integrated equipment and waste gas purification equipment. The company also provides operation and maintenance services, contract energy management, and carbon asset management through its subsidiaries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has proprietary low-temperature vacuum dehydration and drying integrated technology that combines mechanical pressure filtration and vacuum drying to reduce sludge moisture content from 90-99% to below 30%, achieving energy savings and reduced emissions. It also developed high-temperature water source heat pump technology for efficient heat recovery and sludge drying. Core components like high-temperature drying filter plates are self-produced, replacing imported products. Waste gas purification technologies include biofilter and composite physical-chemical methods. The company emphasizes R&D, with collaborations with universities and research institutes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are municipal and industrial wastewater treatment plants, including sectors like coal chemical, lithium battery materials, semiconductor, and petrochemical industries. The company serves government entities and enterprises involved in environmental protection infrastructure. Its projects cover sludge treatment, waste gas purification, and carbon management services, targeting customers requiring advanced environmental protection and energy-saving solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with significant market presence in Shanghai, Guangdong (including Guangzhou), Zhejiang, Jiangsu, and other provinces. It is expanding into the Greater Bay Area, Yangtze River Delta, Southwest China, and exploring international markets such as the Belt and Road countries. Subsidiaries have branches in Guangzhou, Zhengzhou, Wuhan, Hangzhou, and Singapore.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the environmental protection supply chain. It designs, manufactures, and integrates high-end environmental protection equipment and provides operation and maintenance services. It also engages in carbon asset management and energy services, positioning itself as a technology and service provider rather than raw material supplier.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company focuses on strengthening its core sludge dehydration and drying technology, expanding waste gas purification and energy-saving equipment, and developing integrated carbon services. R&D priorities include optimizing low-temperature vacuum dehydration technology, developing new conditioning agents, advancing sludge resource utilization, and innovating high-temperature heat pump technologies. The company invests heavily in digitalization, smart operation, and hydrogen energy storage technologies, aiming to lead in green, low-carbon, and circular economy solutions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through sales of environmental protection equipment (low-temperature vacuum dehydration and drying integrated equipment, waste gas purification equipment), operation and maintenance services, contract energy management, and carbon asset management services. The company uses direct sales, BOT (Build-Operate-Transfer) models, and service contracts to recognize revenue over time or at points of delivery, depending on contract terms.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in sludge dehydration and drying technology, holding a unique proprietary technology that fills a domestic and international gap. It is recognized as a national specialized and innovative 'Little Giant' enterprise and holds significant market share in Shanghai and Guangzhou. The industry is fragmented with many small players; the company’s technological leadership and comprehensive service offerings position it as a market leader in high-end environmental protection equipment.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 576 million, a 27% decrease from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 100 million, down 13%. Despite short-term revenue decline due to market and government fiscal pressures, the company has a compound annual growth rate of over 15% in revenue and 14% in net profit over the past three years. Total assets were about RMB 1.53 billion with net assets of RMB 1.25 billion, indicating a stable financial scale and growth trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company’s unique value proposition lies in its proprietary low-temperature vacuum dehydration and drying integrated technology that achieves high-efficiency sludge treatment with lower energy consumption, reduced carbon emissions, and improved safety compared to traditional two-stage processes. Its self-produced core components reduce costs and reliance on imports. The integration of advanced heat pump technologies and comprehensive carbon management services further differentiates its offerings, enabling customers to achieve environmental compliance, operational cost savings, and carbon reduction goals.
